verdict.rationale: Together AI hosts an llms.txt file (HTTP 200 confirmed by probe) and markdown-served docs pages, plus an agent-skills page and MCP server explicitly designed for agents to look up live docs and write correct code. This directly matches the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of an agent successfully using llms.txt in practice, and no OpenAPI spec (all candidates 404) to complement the docs.
